seed: A recording on the 1200 by 720 laptop window at Next defaults, no flag set, with its clip picked. A real click on the Library header's face opens the shelf, and it opens as the video mock draws it (video.html, #gLibrary, body capped at 118px): a short shelf at the foot, its header and 118pt of scope switch, search and tiles that scroll inside it, so it never splits the column. Before 2026-11-11 it took 225 of the 397pt column and pushed Time off the panel. Opening it takes its room from the near side (PanelOpenRoom, the user 2026-10-24), so Time folds to its header; Properties stays whole and Time's header stays on screen.

steps.note: the clip picked on the laptop window: Properties and Time whole, the Library folded to its header at the foot

steps.comment: A real click on the header's face, left of its scope chip and well clear of its plus.
Its header (45pt) and the mock's 118pt body, a point either way.
